portable_pytest.skip_policy: Visible pytest skips; execute only when separately governed inputs are staged and AAVE_BNS_RUN_EXTERNAL_ASSET_TESTS=1.

neurips_review_alignment.quality: Claims remain evidence-status bounded and computed outputs pass deterministic validation.
neurips_review_alignment.clarity: Environment, public data pin, commands, output locations, resources, and expected digest are documented.
neurips_review_alignment.reproducibility: The credential-free public data-to-results path is executable offline and byte-comparable.
neurips_review_alignment.limitations: Raw refreshes, external historical integration artifacts, non-causal diagnostics, actor uncertainty, and blocked infrastructure evidence are explicit.
